subject: Fast Weight Layers kickoff — long-doc quality
body:
Hi Bruno,

Kickoff for Fast Weight Layers. FWLs sit between the body of a Transformer decoder and the output softmax, and their parameters change based on observed tokens — the performance profile of dynamic evaluation, especially on long documents, but much faster and easier to deploy. Our EMNLP work showed the gains; now I want them in the long-document assistant, where quality visibly degrades past a few thousand tokens.

Milestones: production-shaped implementation evaluated by May 29, long-doc perplexity study by Jun 19, integration decision ahead of the July launch-planning cycle.

Gustavo, Quentin and Chiara are assigned. Staffing and budget please — I know the Q3 sweeps will need real money.

Priya
